subject: Follow-up: pricing & model-mix details for Atlas AI (token volumes / budget)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Follow-up: pricing & model-mix details for Atlas AI (token volumes / budget)

Hi Olivia / Ben —

Great to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap and asks so we can turn this into a clean commercial proposal: 

Summary from call:
- Goal: power Atlas AI’s in-product assistant (chat) + semantic search (embeddings) + a light reranking layer for candidate responses.
- Primary metric: maintain sub-250ms p50 for chat response generation on common prompts; embeddings used in search pipelines; rerank triggered for top-10 results.

Key asks (can you confirm by reply?):
1) Expected monthly token volumes by model type (approximate is fine): chat / embeddings / rerank. If you prefer per-day averages, that’s fine too.
2) Target budget range for hosting the service (monthly) and target $/1M tokens you’re aiming for (you mentioned wanting unit economics under a threshold).
3) Latency/availability requirements and whether you prefer hosted vs committed capacity (we can propose dedicated pools if you need predictability).
4) Any security/compliance constraints (SOC2, VPC, custom KMS) that would affect scope.

What we’ll send next:
- A ballpark cost model with per-model unit economics and a 3-tier pricing scenario (hosted pay-as-you-go, reserved monthly commit, and dedicated/enterprise).
- A short spreadsheet with per-model splits and estimated monthly spend.

I attached the Redwood Pricing Quicksheet (summary) and a blank token estimate template for your convenience. If you can reply with the numbers in #1 and #2 above, we’ll run a model-specific estimate and get a formal quote over to procurement.

Proposed next step: 30-minute procurement+tech sync next week (I’m flexible Wed/Thu).

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & model-mix details for Atlas AI (token volumes / budget)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the templates. We filled in the rough numbers below (these are org-level estimates and subject to refinement after the pilot):

- Chat (interactive assistant): ~15,000,000 tokens / month (primarily short-form prompts + 40-80 token responses)
- Embeddings (semantic search indexes & rerank features): ~2,000,000 tokens / month (mostly 512-dim vectors, offline batch/online embed calls)
- Rerank (on top of search): ~1,000,000 tokens / month (short contexts)

Total: ~18,000,000 tokens / month.

Budget: Our initial target is to keep unit costs at or below $1,000 per 1M tokens averaged across the workload. That puts our target monthly spend at ~ $18k. We can consider committed terms if the unit economics improve.

Security: SOC2 is required; VPC peering preferred but not mandatory for pilot.

Procurement timeline: we aim to sign a pilot SOW in ~3–4 weeks; procurement needs a formal quote + MSA to review.

Happy to join a pricing + procurement call next Thursday 11am PT — does that work for your team?

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Product
Atlas AI

Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & model-mix details for Atlas AI (token volumes / budget)

Thanks Olivia — this is super helpful. A few clarifying notes and immediate next steps so we align the quote to your target: 

Clarifying questions:
- The chat volume assumption (15M/month): is that steady-state or including an initial pilot uplift? If pilot will be lower, call out expected pilot month volume.
- Embeddings: are most of these online per-query calls or bulk re-indexes? That affects per-call unit economics.

Ballpark mapping (we’ll produce a firm quote after confirming the above):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): ballpark $1,100 — $1,400 per 1M tokens (depends on model choice for chat and throughput SLOs)
- Committed monthly (discount for 3–12 month commit): ballpark $850 — $1,000 per 1M tokens
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pools, enterprise package): ballpark $650 — $900 per 1M tokens (likely requires a multi-month commitment and sizing exercise)

We’ll produce a per-model mix estimate showing how chat v. embeddings v. rerank map to specific model variants (and the expected $/1M for each). Rishi will attach a quick unit-econ calc that shows assumptions on sequence length, batching/caching savings, and quantization options.

Next steps:
1) Rishi to share model-level assumptions + unit economics.
2) I’ll prepare a formal quote (hosted + 6-month committed + dedicated option) targeted at hitting your $/1M <= $1,000 goal.
3) Schedule the procurement call Thu 11am PT (I’ll send a calendar invite after confirming Rishi/Dylan availability).

Would you be open to a 30-day pilot with a capped spend to validate latency and quality before committing? Many customers use that to validate both model mix and real unit economics.

—
Marissa

Subject: RE: Follow-up: pricing & model-mix details for Atlas AI (token volumes / budget)

Hi all — adding technical assumptions to make the cost estimate actionable. See attached sample calc (unit_econ_calc.xlsx). Key points: 

Assumptions used for per-1M token math:
- Chat workload: avg prompt 120 tokens, avg response 60 tokens (180 tokens per interaction) -> 15M chat tokens corresponds to ~83k interactions / month.
- Embeddings: avg input length 150 tokens; embeddings engine has lower ops per token than chat model (different model family).
- Rerank: short contexts (avg 80 tokens) applied to top-10 candidates; amortized cost per user request is ~0.12M tokens when combined with chat depending on pipeline.

Suggested model mapping (cost-optimized mix):
- Chat: redwood-chat-large-quant (good latency/cost balance) — target $/1M tokens: $950 (committed) / $1,250 (hosted)
- Embeddings: redwood-embed-lite-8bit — target $/1M tokens: $400 (committed) / $550 (hosted)
- Rerank: redwood-rerank-small — target $/1M tokens: $300 (committed) / $420 (hosted)

Batching/caching savings: we assume prefix caching and continuous batching that reduce effective token compute by ~18% at your projected throughput; we show both raw and cached estimates in the spreadsheet.

Pilot recommendation:
- Start hosted pilot with a 30-day cap ($5k) to validate end-to-end latency and embeddings recall. If pilot matches the assumptions, move to a 6-month committed profile to hit your $/1M target of <= $1,000.

I attached the unit_econ_calc.xlsx with per-model line items, sequence length assumptions, and sensitivity to batching savings. Happy to walk through in the call.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
